resources.string: ShayLock uses this service to detect when Instagram is opened so it can display a full-screen lock screen over it. It only watches which app is in the foreground and blocks the Home, Back and Recents buttons while the lock screen is shown.
Shows an ongoing notification while app blocking is active.
Tap to open the blocker settings.
Warns you when ShayLock protection has been switched off.
ShayLock\'s accessibility service is disabled, so Instagram is no longer being blocked. Tap to re-enable it.
